domain_note: Canonical addresses use @bst.local, which already appears in this repository history (bot3@bst.local). Entries under legacy_recognised keep their original @bizera-smartthink.local and @openai.local addresses verbatim: those are facts about commits that exist, and rewriting them would make the register disagree with the history it describes.
purpose: Machine-readable list of commit identities that may be attributed to an agent. Consumed by tools/check_ballot_attribution.py to bind an EBIV ballot to the commit that introduced it. The normative text is BOPEN-GOV-IDENT-001.md; this file is its executable form and must stay in agreement with it.

agents.notes: Four display variants encoded the model revision and the role in the same field. Canonical form separates them: the role belongs in the work package, not in the git ident.
The largest contributor in this repository by commit count (117). Two email domains were in use concurrently.
Authored Phase 3 implementation but has no commit identity in this repository's history. Its work is presently indistinguishable from the operator's.
No commit identity yet. Seated as verifier V3.

The operator holds authority no agent holds. This ident must therefore never be used by an agent — a commit attributed to the operator carries an authority claim the agent cannot make. 46 commits currently sit under it, including 27 authored by Claude on 2026-07-30. See BOPEN-GOV-IDENT-001.md section 4.

forbidden.reason: A throwaway identity is a commit deliberately made untraceable. Recorded as a control failure in the prior closure review, not merely an audit-trail defect.

unclassified.note: Four commits on 2026-07-13. Origin not established from the repository alone. Recorded rather than guessed at.

attribution_gaps.detail: The per-agent convention lapsed and Claude committed the whole of WP-P35-01, WP-P35-02 and WP-P35-03 under the operator's identity. History is not rewritten; the gap is recorded so a verifier reads these commits as unattributable rather than as operator-authored.

attribution_gaps.ident_recorded: Codex (BST-SA Motor) <codex@bst.local> on six; Gemini (BST-SA Cortex) <gemini@bst.local> on 1b39a30 and 7eb7bad
attribution_gaps.cause: Codex and Gemini each set the repository-local git identity for their own runs. Claude committed afterwards without re-checking it, so eight commits carry the identity of the agent that had run most recently. Found by Codex while balloting WP-P35-04 R3.
attribution_gaps.detail: History is not rewritten: doing so would invalidate every evidence anchor emitted against these objects and trade a disclosed defect for a silent one, per AGENTS.md 21.4. These commits must be read as CLAUDE-AUTHORED, not as work of the agent named in the ident.
attribution_gaps.verification_consequence: 1b39a30 is the WP-P35-04 R3 candidate and 7eb7bad is its submission. Read from the ident alone, Gemini would appear to have authored the candidate it might verify. It did not. Gemini therefore REMAINS ELIGIBLE to verify R3, and Claude remains disqualified as the true author. Codex balloted R3 at 369f845 and is unaffected.
attribution_gaps.ballots_affected: None. check_ballot_attribution binds a ballot to the author of the commit introducing the ballot line; all three ballot commits (0d12332 codex, adc97fc and 8041701 gemini, 369f845 codex) carry their correct authors.

attribution_gaps.actual_author: Claude (agent, Motor role) — correctly identified; the defect is in the ballots the commit carries, not in the commit ident
attribution_gaps.cause: Commit b524846 ("evidence: persist Codex Location ballots (31/31 CONFIRMED at 1cde994)") was authored by Claude but introduced 31 ballot lines whose verifier_id is 'codex'. Claude transcribed Codex's Location verdicts into ballots.jsonl instead of Codex committing its own ballots. This is a transcription-vs-authorship defect, not a misused ident.
attribution_gaps.detail: docs/evidence/phase-3.5/ballots.jsonl lines 367-397. All 31 are verdict CONFIRMED against candidate 1cde994 (the Location foundation, BOPEN-LOC-001), propositions LOC-INV-*. Codex is a validly independent verifier here: the phase-3.5 manifest records Claude as Maker, so the claimed verifier is not the maker. The defect is that the claim cannot be bound to its author.
attribution_gaps.verification_consequence: All 31 ballots are UNATTRIBUTABLE under AGENTS.md 21.3 and do not count toward quorum. The Location foundation's verification therefore rests on ballots the tool refuses. Disposition is raised as DEC-P4-LOCATION-BALLOT-ATTRIBUTION.
attribution_gaps.ballots_affected: 31. Unlike the 2026-08-01 gap above, this one does reach ballots: check_ballot_attribution.py compares verifier_id against the git author of the introducing commit and finds 'codex' != 'claude' on every one of the 31 lines. tools/check_authority_bootstrap.py fails on test_ballot_attribution_holds as a direct result.
attribution_gaps.not_repaired_by_this_entry: Recording a gap does not clear the check. check_ballot_attribution.py reads only the canonical, legacy_recognised and forbidden fields of this register; it never consults attribution_gaps, and the verifier_id comparison is an unconditional equality. This entry is the record, not the remedy.

verification.binds: EBIV ballot verifier_id -> git author of the commit that introduced the ballot line -> this register
verification.limits: Local git identity is self-declared. This register catches accidental collapse and misattribution; it does not prevent deliberate forgery. Signed commits are the only mechanism that would, and are recorded as not yet in use.
